title: 第5章 大船第6章 师叔祖
slug: 本掌门负债成仙第158章陷阱
content_zh:
三小只察觉到不对，也赶快跑了出来。
他们这几年享受的催债比花乾多，早练就了一身识别债主的本事。
“大船，大船！”元宝兴奋地蹦个不停，好像他多跳几下，就能直接蹦到灵船上似的。
萧时乐微皱着眉头，看着上方，老气横秋地说：“师姐，来人看起来很强，务必要小心。”
花乾不屑地冷哼了一声，“有护山大阵在，你们就放宽心吧，这可是师祖他老人家亲手布下的阵。”
“师父曾经说过，当年有十万修士围攻我们守灵门，整整三年都是无用功，根本就打不破我们的大阵。”
如此厉害，元宝是听不太懂了，萧时乐则整个人震惊了，门派以前竟然这么强大，平时完全看不出来啊！
冷魔艳却完全不给面子地说道：“我们又不是魔门，怎么可能有这么多修士过来攻打，闻所未闻。”
“你一个小孩知道什么，就不许师祖仇家多吗？师父也是听他的师父说的，这还能有假？”花乾拔高声音训道。
怎么有这种喜欢灭自己威风，涨别人志气的小孩，真是太不会做人了。
冷魔艳不服地反驳道：“我只是说十万修士太多了，这得多坏才能有这么多仇家。”
花乾瞅了她一眼，“你怎么能小瞧师祖他老人家，一点尊重也没有，也许他老人家是从良隐退的绝世大魔头呢？”
“师姐，你身为掌门，这样说师祖的坏话好吗？”冷魔艳无语地看着她，这家伙才是一点敬意都没有，还好意思说别人。
“不对，师祖肯定是大好人！”元宝在一旁总算是听明白了，顿时紧捏着他的木剑大喊起来。
花乾居高临下地看着他，“你凭什么说师祖是好人？”
“因为我要做最厉害的剑侠，当个大英雄，所以师祖肯定是好人！”元宝气呼呼地嚷道。
真是可笑。
花乾冷笑道：“师祖又不是你爹，你当你的剑侠，师祖做他的大魔头，凭什么要因为你就要变成好人。”
“我不管，师祖就是好人！掌门师姐才是大坏蛋！”
“师祖是大魔头。”

“师姐你才是坏人！”
“师祖是魔头，一朝建派，十万仇家上门。”
守灵门的掌门为了说师祖的坏话，和一个六岁的孩子，当着全门派总共两人的面吵了起来。
花乾很肯定师祖不是好人，好人怎么可能留下这么坏的掌门令，死了都要欺负人。
好人怎么会对自家小辈下这么重的手，正好趁这个机会多骂他几句，过过嘴瘾。
一大一小吵得激烈，萧时乐长长地叹了口气，只能抬头看着头顶的灵船，不知道对方是什么人，想要干嘛。
但总比看这两个笨蛋强多了。
突然，灵船上有加持了法术的声音传来，震耳欲聋，使得整个守灵门地界的人都听得一清二楚。
“守灵门的弟子听着，速速打开大阵投降，本座可以饶你不死，让你入本派成为内门弟子。如若不然，便与这守灵门同归于尽。”
“是北斗宗的庞老祖！”守在山门处的修士认出了这是谁，顿时议论纷纷起来。
他们早发现这艘挂着北斗宗旗帜的灵船了，只是不知道来的是谁，现在听这个嚣张的声音，就马上认出来了。
“庞老祖亲自出马，这守灵门的大阵怕是守不住了。”
“守灵门连北斗宗的债也欠了？差距这么大也有交情，这都不是我们宁梨州的人。”
“你真蠢，守灵门虽然实力不怎么样，但地盘在，早就让人垂涎三尺，一直有人打这块地盘的主意。”
“就算没欠债，现在守灵门又没人，掌门都失踪跑路，当然是谁抢到就归谁的。”
“其它门派现在还没动手，才是死要面子活受罪呢。”
太元真人听着周围的议论，神情凝重的看着北斗宗的灵船。他早派人回去送信，没想到还是让北斗宗抢先来了。
这位庞老祖他自然熟悉，听过他们干的很多坏事。
北斗宗并不在宁梨州，而是在隔壁的清方州，离得并不远。
他们门派行事嚣张，总是捞过界，跑到宁梨州的地界上来搞事，主要是每次来的都是他，让这边的门派和修士很是厌恶。
content_en:
The three little ones realized something was wrong and ran out quickly.
In the past few years, they have enjoyed more debt collection than Huagan, and they have already developed the ability to identify creditors.
"Big ship, big ship!" Yuan Bao kept jumping excitedly, as if he could jump directly to the spirit ship if he jumped a few more times.
Xiao Shile frowned slightly, looked up, and said arrogantly: "Senior sister, this person looks very strong, so be careful."
Huagan snorted disdainfully, "There is a mountain-protecting formation here, so you can relax. This formation was set up by the master himself."
"Master once said that there were 100,000 monks who besieged our Soul Guarding Gate for three whole years. Their efforts were in vain and they could not break our formation at all."
It was so powerful that Yuan Bao couldn't understand it, and Xiao Shile was shocked. The sect was so powerful before, and it was completely invisible to him at ordinary times!
However, Leng Moyan said without any shame: "We are not a demon sect. How could there be so many monks coming to attack? This is unheard of."
"What do you know as a child? Why don't you allow your master to have many enemies? Master also listened to his master. How can this be false?" Hua Ganba lectured in a loud voice.
How come there is such a child who likes to destroy his own prestige and boost other people's ambitions? He really doesn't know how to behave.
Leng Moyan retorted unconvinced: "I just said that one hundred thousand monks is too many. How bad must this be to have so many enemies."
Hua Gan glanced at her and said, "How can you underestimate Master and have no respect at all for him? Maybe he is a great devil who has retired from good deeds?"
"Senior sister, as the leader, can you speak ill of our master like this?" Leng Moyan looked at her speechlessly. This guy has no respect at all, and he has the nerve to speak ill of others.
"No, the master must be a good man!" Yuan Bao finally understood and shouted while squeezing his wooden sword tightly.
Hua Gan looked at him condescendingly, "Why do you say that Master is a good person?"
"Because I want to be the most powerful swordsman and a great hero, so the master must be a good person!" Yuan Bao shouted angrily.
How ridiculous.
Hua Gan sneered: "Master is not your father. You are your swordsman and Master is his big devil. Why should I become a good person just because of you?"
"I don't care, the master is a good person! The head sister is the big bad guy!"
"Master is a big devil."
"Sister, you are the bad guy!"
"The master is a demon. Once the sect is established, hundreds of thousands of enemies will come to visit."
In order to speak ill of the master, the head of the Soul Watching Sect got into an argument with a six-year-old child in front of the entire sect.
Hua Gan was very sure that his master was not a good person. How could a good person leave such a bad leader's order and bully others even if he dies?
How could a good person be so harsh to his junior? He just took this opportunity to scold him a few more words to satisfy his cravings.
The big one and the small one were arguing fiercely. Xiao Shile let out a long sigh and could only look up at the spirit ship above his head. He didn't know who the other party was and what he wanted to do.
But it's better than watching these two idiots.
Suddenly, a voice blessed with magic came from the spirit boat. It was deafening, so that everyone in the entire Soul Guarding Gate could hear it clearly.
"Listen to the disciples of the Soul Guarding Sect. Quickly open the formation and surrender. I can spare your life and allow you to join our sect and become an inner disciple. If not, you will perish together with the Soul Guarding Sect."
"It's Patriarch Pang of the Beidou Sect!" The monks guarding the mountain gate recognized who it was and started talking about it.
They had already discovered this spiritual ship with the Beidou Sect's flag, but they didn't know who it was. Now that they heard this arrogant voice, they recognized it immediately.
"Old Ancestor Pang personally took action. I am afraid that the large formation guarding the spirit gate will not be able to hold it."
"Shou Lingmen also owes Beidou Sect's debt? There is a friendship with such a huge gap. These are not from Ningli Province."
"You're so stupid. Even though the guardian sect is powerful,It's not great, but the land is there, and people have been coveting it for a long time. There are always people who want to take advantage of this land. "
"Even if there is no debt, there is no one in the guarding gate now, and the leader has disappeared and ran away, of course it belongs to whoever grabs it. "
“The other sects haven’t taken action yet because they want to save face and suffer the consequences. "
Master Taiyuan listened to the discussions around him and looked at the Beidou Sect's spirit ship with a solemn expression. He had already sent someone back to deliver the message, but to his surprise, Beidou Sect came first.
He is naturally familiar with this Patriarch Pang and has heard many bad things they did.
Beidou Sect is not in Ningli Prefecture, but in Qingfang Prefecture next door, which is not far away.
Their sect acted arrogantly and always crossed the border to cause trouble in Ningli Prefecture. The main reason was that it was him who came every time, which made the sect and monks here very disgusted.
